defects: Does not use Mathlib's `symplecticGroup l R`; instead reformulates with an arbitrary matrix J satisfying only `IsUnit J.det`, rather than the fixed canonical symplectic form (block matrix built from identity blocks) that `symplecticGroup` uses
Replaces the block-indexed matrix type `Matrix (l ⊕ l) (l ⊕ l) R` with `Matrix (Fin (2*n)) (Fin (2*n)) R`, losing the block structure that underlies the definition of symplecticGroup
Introduces an extra hypothesis `IsUnit J.det` that is not part of the original definition (the canonical J is always invertible with det 1)

The resulting statement is a strict generalization that is mathematically false: taking J = I and M an orthogonal matrix with det M = -1 satisfies both hypotheses (M^T J M = J, IsUnit J.det) but violates the conclusion (det M = 1), so the produced theorem does not correctly capture the intended proposition
Drops the `DecidableEq l`/`Fintype l` typeclass context relevant to the actual symplectic group definition
